title: County of Marin projects and campaigns
notes: One entry per project. The apps that show a project use it from here: Marin Links as a campaign, Marin Reach in its Project filter, and Marin Mentions as a watched name.
An id is permanent. Never reuse or rename an id.
links.code is the value Marin Links sends in a link. It is permanent: never change, reuse, or renumber a code. links.legacy lists older values that mean the same project.

An entry only appears in the apps it names: links for Marin Links, reach for Marin Reach, mentions for Marin Mentions. mentions.include lists the phrases Marin Mentions watches for. A project needs no details to show up.
The order of this list does not matter. Each app sorts as it needs to.
